annotations.text:
Traced from ui/ui.c on the device. 800x480 fixed panel.
Header 66 / rule 1 / page 387 / dots 26 - the nav bar is gone, swipe moves between pages.
Cards: 18px pad, 12px radius, 1px border. Bars 14px tall, 7px radius.
Type is Montserrat 14 / 28 / 48 - the only three sizes compiled into the firmware.

Changing anything here is a mockup, not the firmware - I port edits back into ui/ui.c by hand.
Safe to change: sizes, spacing, colour, position, copy, what goes where.
Costly: new font sizes (each adds flash).
Avoid: gradients, shadows, blur - the RGB panel tears on heavy redraws.
Swipe needs LVGL gesture handling in ui.c; the dots are the only affordance left.
